column3: BSB starts a new sentence with “They will.”
BSB follows the critical text with “depravity” (ἀσελγείαις); the Textus Receptus reads “destructive ways.”
BSB adds “these false teachers” and renders “is not idle” as “remains in force.”
BSB renders “the eighth” as “among the eight.”
BSB adds “if all this is so.”
BSB adds “Such punishment is specially reserved.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the harm they will suffer” (ἀδικούμενοι); the Textus Receptus reads “will receive.”
BSB follows the critical text with “mists” (ὁμίχλαι) and without “forever.”
BSB follows the critical text with “just escaping” (ὀλίγως); the Textus Receptus reads “truly escaped.”
BSB supplies the verbs “returns” and “goes back.”
